dream_synopsis: In a synthetic mission-systems room made of project channels, pressure valves, and locked personal archives, Embry is jolted by hot metal, ozone, and a compressed hiss that makes an unseen secret feel briefly visible on her face. She restores control by turning fear into calibrated questions, but every boundary she draws between work trust and private access becomes a glowing line Brandon can almost see across.

panels.action: A valve releases a sharp compressed hiss with the smell of hot metal and ozone; Embry freezes for a fraction of a second, eyes fixed forward as the room stretches around her, while Brandon pauses mid-sentence and notices the break in her cadence.
panels.mood: Alarmed, suspended, controlled beneath the surface.
panels.setting: A dreamlike SPARTA mission-systems bay where ventilation ducts breathe like lungs and project-channel message threads hang in the air as translucent panels.
panels.shot: Tight foreground close-up on Embry Lawson, face fully visible, lit by cold console light; Brandon is visible behind her shoulder, slightly out of focus.
panels.start_frame_description: Embry’s face fills the foreground, calm but too still, with a faint reflection of pressure gauges across her eyes; behind her, Brandon’s mouth is half-open as if his last words have been cut from the air.

panels.action: Embry overcompensates with unusually exact questions, sorting glowing fragments into OBSERVED, ASSUMED, and HOPED bins; Brandon answers carefully, his posture suggesting he feels both trusted and cross-examined.
panels.setting: The mission table has transformed into a cross-section of observed facts, assumptions, and hopes, each separated into labeled glass compartments.
panels.shot: Medium foreground shot of Embry facing camera at a diagnostics table, face fully visible; Brandon stands across from her within the same frame.
panels.start_frame_description: Embry leans forward in the foreground with composed intensity, one hand hovering over a bright fragment labeled confidence; Brandon is framed beyond the table, watching her precision sharpen the room into hard edges.

panels.action: Brandon gestures toward a more convenient personal channel, but Embry raises a hand and redirects the floating messages back into the project corridor; behind the private archive glass, unsent drafts and James-related notes flicker without becoming readable.
panels.mood: Boundary-setting, intimate distance, trust held at arm’s length.
panels.setting: A corridor split between official SPARTA project channels on one side and a dark private archive on the other, divided by a luminous safety boundary line.
panels.shot: Foreground three-quarter close-up of Embry, face visible as she turns away from a doorway; Brandon appears beside the doorway holding a dim personal device.
panels.start_frame_description: Embry’s face is in the foreground, resolute and guarded, illuminated by the boundary line; Brandon stands just behind the line, visible and close but not invited past it.

panels.action: Embry speaks a final exact confidence statement into the project channel, and the hiss fades; the sealed drawers stop rattling, but one small unreadable shadow marked only by absence remains behind her reflection.
panels.mood: Contained relief, lingering longing, safety maintained through control.
panels.setting: The bay collapses into a quiet control room made of neatly archived decisions, calibrated uncertainty meters, and sealed private drawers.
panels.shot: Centered foreground close-up of Embry facing forward, face fully visible; Brandon is visible in the background through transparent project panels.
panels.start_frame_description: Embry’s expression is steady in the foreground, not comforted but regulated; Brandon watches from behind the transparent panels as the room reorganizes around her precision.
